subject: DI03000141

intro_text.en: Diagram-first notes: identify parts, understand construction, follow working and practise only the syllabus numericals.
intro_text.gu: પહેલાં labelled diagram, પછી parts, Construction અને step-by-step Working. Syllabus પ્રમાણે જ numericals.

h.en: 3.1.1 Friction: terminology, types and useful applications

body.en:
Friction is the contact force opposing actual or impending relative tangential motion. Static friction adjusts up to a limit; limiting friction Fmax=mu_s N. Sliding/kinetic friction is approximately Fk=mu_k N in a simple dry-friction model. Rolling resistance arises mainly from deformation and is not the same sliding law.

Angle of friction satisfies tan(phi)=mu at limiting friction; angle of repose equals phi for an ideal block just about to slide on an inclined plane. Friction enables gripping, clutches and braking but wastes power in bearings. Normal force is not always equal to weight.
body.gu:
Friction actual/impending tangential relative motion oppose કરે. Static friction જરૂર મુજબ limit સુધી: Fmax=mu_s N. Sliding માટે simple model Fk=mu_k N. Rolling resistance deformation થી આવે; sliding law જેવું નથી.

Limiting condition પર tan(phi)=mu; ideal incline પર angle of repose=phi. Gripping/clutch/brake માટે friction ઉપયોગી, bearing માં power loss. Normal force હંમેશાં weight જેટલું નથી.

h.en: 3.1.2 Worked friction example: do not assume impending motion

body.en:
A 400 N block rests on a horizontal surface with mu_s=0.25. No other vertical force acts, so N=400 N and limiting friction=100 N. If a horizontal pull of 60 N is applied, static friction is 60 N, not 100 N, and the block remains at rest.

A pull exceeding 100 N initiates sliding under this ideal model. If mu_k=0.20 once sliding starts, kinetic friction becomes 80 N. Draw weight downward, normal upward and friction opposite the actual/impending relative movement before writing equations.
body.gu:
Horizontal surface પર 400 N block, mu_s=.25: N400 N, limiting friction100 N. Pull60 N હોય તો actual static friction60 N, 100 N નહિ; block rest માં રહે.

Ideal model માં pull100 N કરતાં વધારે થાય ત્યારે sliding શરૂ. પછી mu_k=.20 હોય તો friction80 N. પહેલાં free-body diagram માં weight, normal અને actual/impending motion સામે friction દોરો.

body.en:
Uniform pressure assumes p is constant over the contact annulus, often an idealisation of newly fitted surfaces. Uniform wear assumes wear rate proportional to p×sliding speed and equal wear everywhere; because speed is omega r, pr=constant. This models a run-in friction surface.

For axial force W, coefficient mu, outer radius ro and inner ri: torque T=mu W Rm. Uniform-pressure mean radius Rm=(2/3)(ro³−ri³)/(ro²−ri²); uniform-wear Rm=(ro+ri)/2. Choose the stated theory; do not average these formulas. Use metres and newtons to obtain N·m.
body.gu:
Uniform pressure માં contact પર p constant, નવા fitted surface નું ideal model. Uniform wear માં wear rate p×sliding speed પર આધારિત અને equal; તેથી pr=constant, કારણ speed=omega r.

T=mu W Rm. UP માટે Rm=(2/3)(ro³−ri³)/(ro²−ri²); UW માટે Rm=(ro+ri)/2. Question ની theory જ લો. Radius metres, W newtons લેવાથી torque N·m મળે.

h.en: 3.2.2 Flat pivot and conical pivot bearings
h.gu: 3.2.2 Flat Pivot અને Conical Pivot Bearings

body.en:
Flat pivot construction: a shaft end rests on a stationary thrust surface. Axial load creates normal pressure; relative rotation creates resisting friction torque. For a solid circular contact R: UP torque=(2/3)mu W R, UW torque=(1/2)mu W R. The wear model at the exact centre is an ideal limiting assumption.

A conical pivot uses mating conical surfaces. If alpha is the semi-cone angle to the shaft axis and Rm is based on projected radii, T=mu W Rm/sin(alpha). Larger normal reaction gives greater torque for a given W. This formula is not obtained by using the full included cone angle.
body.gu:
Flat pivot માં shaft end stationary thrust face પર axial load આપે; rotation friction torque બનાવે. Solid radius R માટે UP T=(2/3)muWR; UW T=(1/2)muWR. Centre પર wear law ideal limiting model છે.

Conical pivot માં mating cone surfaces હોય. Alpha shaft axis સાથે semi-cone angle હોય તો T=muW Rm/sin(alpha), projected radii મુજબ Rm. Full included angle વાપરવો નહિ.

body.en:
Construction: a collar fixed to the shaft bears against a stationary annular thrust surface; several collars provide multiple contact areas for larger loads. Working: axial thrust passes from shaft collars to the housing, while friction resists rotation.

Single collar: T=mu W Rm. Multiple collars: add the torque from each loaded face, sum(mu Wi Rmi). If n identical collars share a total thrust W equally, each carries W/n and total torque remains mu W Rm for that ideal distribution. Multiply by n only if W is explicitly the load on each face. Real load sharing may be unequal.
body.gu:
Collar shaft સાથે fixed અને stationary annular thrust face સામે load આપે. Multiple collars થી contact area વધે; axial thrust housing સુધી જાય અને friction rotation oppose કરે.

Single: T=muWRm. Multiple: દરેક loaded face માટે muWiRmi ઉમેરીએ. n identical collars total W equally વહેંચે તો દરેક W/n અને total T=muWRm. W per face આપેલું હોય ત્યારે જ n multiply. Actual sharing unequal હોઈ શકે.

h.en: 3.2.4 Bearing numerical: mean radius, torque and power loss
h.gu: 3.2.4 Bearing Numerical: Mean Radius, Torque અને Power

body.en:
Given a single annular collar: W=1000 N, mu=0.08, ro=60 mm=0.06 m, ri=30 mm=0.03 m, N=600 rpm. UP mean radius=(2/3)(0.06³−0.03³)/(0.06²−0.03²)=0.04667 m, so T=3.733 N·m. UW mean radius=(.06+.03)/2=.045 m, so T=3.60 N·m.

Power loss P=T omega=T(2pi N/60). UP gives 234.6 W; UW gives 226.2 W. Show both only for comparison; a normal question expects the specified theory. This is lost mechanical power, not useful bearing output.
body.gu:
Given W1000 N, mu.08, ro60 mm=.06 m, ri30 mm=.03 m, N600 rpm. UP Rm=.04667 m એટલે T3.733 N·m; UW Rm=.045 m એટલે T3.60 N·m.

P=T(2piN/60). UP234.6 W, UW226.2 W. અહીં comparison માટે બંને; exam માં specified theory લો. આ friction માં lost power છે, bearing useful output નહિ.

h.en: 3.3.1 Single plate clutch: engagement and release
h.gu: 3.3.1 Single Plate Clutch: Engagement અને Release

body.en:
Construction: engine flywheel, friction-lined plate on a splined driven shaft, pressure plate, spring system, cover and release mechanism. Common single plates have two active friction interfaces. Splines permit axial movement while transmitting shaft torque.

Working: with release pedal released, springs clamp the friction plate between flywheel and pressure plate, transmitting torque to the gearbox shaft. Pressing the pedal moves the release bearing/levers to reduce clamp, permitting slip and separation. Slip during engagement converts energy to heat; prolonged slipping damages linings. Pedal release is not the same as clutch disengagement.
body.gu:
Construction: flywheel, splined driven shaft પર lined friction plate, pressure plate, springs, cover અને release system. Single plate માં સામાન્ય રીતે બે active faces હોય. Splines axial movement સાથે torque transmit કરે.

Pedal છોડતાં spring clamp થાય અને torque gearbox shaft સુધી જાય. Pedal દબાવતાં release bearing/levers clamp ઘટાડે, clutch disengage થાય. Engagement slip heat બનાવે; prolonged slipping lining ખરાબ કરે.

body.en:
Construction: alternating driving plates are keyed to an outer drum and driven plates to an inner hub; a pressure plate and springs clamp the stack. Plates slide axially but rotate with their respective drum or hub. Wet designs operate in oil; dry designs do not.

Working: clamping creates friction at many interfaces, passing torque from drum to hub. Releasing clamp lets plates slip. For the same axial load, material coefficient and mean radius, more active faces increase ideal torque capacity. Oil improves cooling and engagement but changes friction coefficient; never use a dry coefficient for an unspecified wet clutch.
body.gu:
Construction: alternate driving plates outer drum સાથે અને driven plates inner hub સાથે keyed હોય. Pressure plate/springs stack clamp કરે. Plates axial slide થાય પણ respective member સાથે ફરે. Wet design oil માં ચાલે.

Clamping થી અનેક interfaces પર friction torque મળે; clamp release કરતાં slip થાય. Same W,mu,Rm માટે active faces વધવાથી torque capacity વધે. Wet clutch માટે dry coefficient વાપરવો નહિ.

body.en:
Construction: shoes with friction linings are carried by the driving hub inside a driven drum; return springs hold them inward at low speed.

Working: increasing hub speed raises the outward inertial force tendency proportional to omega². Above the designed engagement speed the shoes contact the drum and normal force creates tangential friction torque. As speed falls, springs pull shoes back. Used in small automatic drives such as scooters and tools. Engagement is gradual and load-dependent; a rotating hub at low speed need not drive the drum. Guarding is essential.
body.gu:
Construction: driving hub પર friction-lined shoes, બહાર driven drum અને inward return springs.

Hub speed વધતાં outward force tendency omega² મુજબ વધે. Designed engagement speed ઉપર shoes drum ને touch કરી friction torque આપે. Speed ઘટતાં springs shoes પાછાં ખેંચે. Scooters/small automatic drives માં ઉપયોગ. Low-speed hub ફરતું હોય છતાં drum drive જરૂરી નથી; engagement load-dependent છે.

h.en: 3.3.4 Cone clutch: axial clamp and normal reaction
h.gu: 3.3.4 Cone Clutch: Axial Clamp અને Normal Reaction

body.en:
Construction: a conical male friction member slides axially on the driven shaft into a matching female member connected to the driver; spring force engages it and a release system withdraws it.

Working: axial clamping creates larger normal reaction on the inclined faces, enabling torque transmission. Under the simple model T=mu W Rm/sin(alpha). A small semi-cone angle increases normal force but can cause sticking and difficult release; do not select it from torque capacity alone. Conical clutch and conical thrust bearing share a friction model but serve different functions.
body.gu:
Construction: driven shaft પર axially sliding male cone, driver સાથે female cone, engagement spring અને release system.

Axial clamp inclined faces પર મોટી normal reaction આપે અને torque transmit થાય. Simple model T=muWRm/sin(alpha). નાનો semi-angle capacity વધારે પણ sticking/release મુશ્કેલી લાવી શકે. Cone clutch torque connect/disconnect કરે; conical bearing thrust support કરે.

h.en: 3.3.5 Diaphragm clutch: spring and release fingers
h.gu: 3.3.5 Diaphragm Clutch: Spring અને Release Fingers

body.en:
Construction: a dished annular diaphragm spring with radial fingers acts between clutch cover and pressure plate, supported on fulcrum rings. A release bearing contacts the inner fingers; flywheel, friction disc and driven splines complete the assembly.

Working: in engagement the spring outer region clamps the pressure plate. Moving the release bearing deflects the inner fingers; the spring pivots about its fulcrum and unloads the pressure plate. It is a spring/release arrangement, often used with a single friction plate, not necessarily a separate friction-contact shape. Compared with many coil springs it offers compact, more uniform clamp action.
body.gu:
Construction: radial fingers ધરાવતી dished diaphragm spring cover/pressure plate વચ્ચે fulcrum rings પર હોય; release bearing inner fingers ને touch કરે. Flywheel, friction disc, splines બાકીના parts.

Engagement માં outer spring region pressure plate clamp કરે. Release bearing inner fingers deflect કરતાં spring fulcrum પર pivot થઈ plate unload કરે. આ spring/release arrangement છે; ઘણીવાર single friction plate સાથે વપરાય.

h.en: 3.3.6 Clutch torque numericals: single and multi-plate
h.gu: 3.3.6 Clutch Torque Numericals: Single અને Multi-plate

body.en:
Uniform-wear clutch: mu=.30, axial force W=2000 N, ro=.10 m, ri=.06 m. Rm=(.10+.06)/2=.08 m. For a single plate with both sides active, n=2: T=n mu W Rm=96 N·m. At 1000 rpm, P=2piNT/60=10.05 kW.

If a fully active alternating stack has three driving and two driven plates, n=3+2−1=4 and T=192 N·m with the same W. Count actual interfaces: a backed-off, unlined or inactive face is not counted. The axial force is carried through the stack; it is not divided by n in this standard clutch formula.
body.gu:
UW clutch: mu.30, W2000 N, ro.10 m, ri.06 m → Rm.08 m. Single plate બંને sides active હોય તો n2, T=2×.30×2000×.08=96 N·m. N1000 rpm પર P10.05 kW.

Fully active alternating 3 driving+2 driven stack માટે n=3+2−1=4, T192 N·m. Actual friction interfaces ગણો; inactive face નહિ. Standard clutch formula માં W axial stack load છે, n થી divide નહિ.

body.en:
Block brake construction: a lined block is carried on a lever near a rotating drum. Applying lever force presses the block against the drum; tangential friction opposes drum rotation, and the frame takes reaction torque. Rotation direction affects the lever moment and self-energising tendency.

Band brake construction: a flexible lined band partly surrounds a drum; one end is anchored and the other operated by a lever. Applying the lever increases band tension and normal pressure, producing braking torque. Tight/slack ends depend on rotation and anchoring; a diagram must show the drum arrow. Brakes remove energy as heat. No brake numericals are required here.
body.gu:
Block brake: lever પર lined block drum પાસે હોય. Lever effort થી block drum પર press થાય; tangential friction rotation oppose કરે અને frame reaction torque લે. Rotation direction lever moment/self-energising બદલે.

Band brake: flexible lined band drum પર wrap થાય, એક end anchored અને બીજો lever operated. Leverથી tension/normal pressure વધતાં braking torque મળે. Tight/slack ends માટે rotation arrow જરૂરી. આ unit માં brake numericals નહિ.

h.en: 3.4.2 Band-and-block and internal expanding shoe brakes
h.gu: 3.4.2 Band-and-block અને Internal Expanding Shoe Brakes

body.en:
Band-and-block construction: separate friction blocks are attached to a flexible band surrounding the drum. Tension in the band presses the blocks against the surface; replaceable blocks provide the friction contact while the band carries tensile force.

Internal expanding brake construction: two curved lined shoes sit inside a drum and are expanded by a cam or wheel cylinder against return springs. Working: shoes press outward on the inner drum; friction produces torque resisted at anchor/backplate. Releasing effort lets springs retract the shoes. Leading/trailing behaviour changes with direction. Never inhale brake dust or disturb a real assembly without proper procedures.
body.gu:
Band-and-block: flexible band પર separate friction blocks હોય. Band tension blocks ને drum પર દબાવે; blocks friction આપે અને band tensile force વહન કરે.

Internal expanding: drum અંદર curved lined shoes, expander/wheel cylinder, anchors અને return springs. Effort થી shoes બહાર press થાય, braking torque backplate/anchor લે. Release પર springs retract કરે. Leading/trailing behaviour direction મુજબ બદલાય. Brake dust inhale ન કરવો.

body.en:
Disc brake construction: a rotor fixed to the wheel/shaft runs between pads held by a stationary caliper. Hydraulic pistons or a mechanical actuator clamp the pads.

Working: clamping generates friction on the rotating disc; reaction torque passes through the caliper mount to the vehicle structure. Release reduces clamping; disc exposure assists heat rejection. A clutch couples rotating members to transmit useful power; a brake couples a moving member to a stationary reaction structure to reduce/control motion. Both need suitable lining, heat capacity and controlled contact. A brake is not designed merely from high friction coefficient.
body.gu:
Disc brake માં shaft/wheel સાથે rotor અને stationary caliper માં pads હોય. Hydraulic/mechanical actuator pads clamp કરે.

Friction rotor ને resist કરે અને caliper mount reaction structure સુધી torque આપે. Release પર clamp ઘટે; exposed disc heat reject કરે. Clutch rotating members જોડીને power transmit કરે; brake motion control/reduce માટે stationary reaction structure સાથે friction આપે. બંનેમાં lining અને heat capacity જરૂરી.

body.en:
Construction: a rope wraps around a drum/flywheel on the test shaft. One end carries a dead load and the other connects to a spring balance; cooling removes heat. Effective rope radius is drum radius plus half rope diameter.

Working: rotation produces different end tensions, whose difference creates an absorbing torque. If W and S are forces in newtons, T=(W−S)Reff; if scale readings are masses in kilograms, first multiply their difference by g. Brake power=2piNT/60. Read at steady speed, with calibrated instruments and guarding; this formula is not a construction instruction for an improvised live test.
body.gu:
Construction: test shaft ના drum પર rope wrap, એક end dead load અને બીજો spring balance; cooling જરૂરી. Effective radius=drum radius+half rope diameter.

Working: end tensions difference થી torque T=(W−S)Reff, જ્યારે W,S newtons હોય. Kilogram readings હોય તો difference×g કરો. Brake power=2piNT/60. Steady speed/calibration/guarding જરૂરી; improvised live test માટે સૂચના નથી.

body.en:
Construction: a shaft-driven rotor runs inside a water-filled stator casing; water passages, inlet/outlet control, cooling and a casing torque arm with load measurement are provided.

Working: the rotor accelerates water, and fluid motion transfers reaction torque to the stator. Water shear/turbulence converts mechanical power into heat, which the water flow removes. The measured casing reaction F at arm length l gives T=Fl and P=T omega. Changing water fill/flow controls absorbed load. This is an absorption dynamometer, not a hydraulic pump efficiency test inferred from pressure alone.
body.gu:
Construction: water-filled stator casing અંદર shaft rotor, inlet/outlet controls, cooling અને torque arm/load cell.

Working: rotor water accelerate કરે; fluid reaction stator ને torque આપે. Shear/turbulence power ને heat માં બદલે અને flowing water heat દૂર કરે. Arm length l પર measured F થી T=Fl; P=T omega. Fill/flow થી load control. Pressure reading એકલી torque નથી.

body.en:
Construction: a conductive rotor is driven within an excited magnetic field; stator, excitation coils, reaction torque arm/load cell and cooling system complete the unit.

Working: rotor motion through the field induces eddy currents. Their magnetic effect opposes relative motion, absorbing shaft power; reaction torque is measured at the stator, and rotor heating is removed by cooling. Excitation controls load within the machine limits. It provides smooth controllable absorption but does not measure torque simply by reading coil current without calibration. Choose a dynamometer by speed, torque, continuous heat rejection and control range.
body.gu:
Construction: conductive rotor excited magnetic field માં ફરે; stator/coils, torque arm/load cell અને cooling જરૂરી.

Working: motion થી eddy currents induce થાય; તેમની magnetic effect motion oppose કરી power absorb કરે. Stator reaction થી torque માપીએ અને heat cooling થી દૂર કરીએ. Excitation load control કરે. Coil current એકલું calibrated torque નથી. Speed, torque, cooling અને control range મુજબ પસંદગી.

items.f:
UP: Rm=(2/3)(ro³−ri³)/(ro²−ri²)
UW: Rm=(ro+ri)/2
T=mu W Rm

terms.en: W is axial load for flat contact. Sum individual loaded collar faces.
terms.gu: Flat contact માં W axial load; loaded collar faces અલગ ગણો.

items.f:
T=n mu W Rm
Cone: T=mu W Rm/sin(alpha)
P(W)=2pi N(rpm) T(Nm)/60

Rope: T=(W−S)(D+d)/2
Reaction arm: T=F l

terms.en: W and S are forces in newtons; diameters in metres.

a.en: No; that is its limiting value.
